advancements.vampires.01_first_blood.des: Prey on your first victim... With enough bloodshed, you can lure out stronger opponents.
advancements.vampires.10_notoriety.title: Notoriety
advancements.vampires.10_notoriety.descr: After 10 kills, you've caught the attention of the wider human society. Watch out, new foes will soon appear...
advancements.vampires.20_assassin.title: Assassin
advancements.vampires.20_assassin.descri: After 20 kills, they're sending out some real heavy-hitters. Watch out for Illusioners... They might know the way to the Frosted Prison.
advancements.vampires.30_rampager.title: Rampager
advancements.vampires.30_rampager.descri: After 30 kills, reinforcement drills and summoner spellcasters are being sent after you... Keep taking them out.
advancements.vampires.40_monster.title: Monster
advancements.vampires.40_monster.descrip: After 40 kills, Legioner knights are on your tail. Their metal is impressive... Take it.
advancements.vampires.50_destroyer.title: Destroyer
advancements.vampires.50_destroyer.descr: After 50 kills, Infernal Pyreillagers begin raining hellfire down upon you. Slaying one might lead you to a Dragon Tower
advancements.vampires.60_harbinger.title: Harbinger
advancements.vampires.60_harbinger.descr: After 60 kills, infusions of magic and metal now chase you. Show them they're not as tough as they look.
advancements.vampires.70_annihilator.des: After 70 kills, the strongest mages of the Illager Empire have been deployed. Take out an Electrocutioner to find the Acropolis.
advancements.vampires.80_calamity.title: Calamity
advancements.vampires.80_calamity.descri: After 80 kills, new experimental technology is after you. Watch out for the Prowler, lest they tear you to pieces.
advancements.vampires.90_omen.title: Omen
advancements.vampires.90_omen.descriptio: After 90 kills, the Hallowed Knights of Heaven descend down upon you. A mark of the end times.
advancements.vampires.100_nightmare.desc: After 100 kills... A nightmare awakens in your heart. Deal with the consequences of your actions.

advancements.vampires.fire_boss.descript: Your final challenge... Slay the Abyssal Lord, Tyros, and lay your claim upon this world!
